set.body:
Draft the detail and graph vocabulary ADR for owner decision: detail kinds, fidelity/content/processing distinctions, cast identifiers and the bridge to existing event/recall types. Plan: docs/plans/2026-11-16-detail-mapping-plan.md. Internal/external is a derived analysis; record its target episode, versioned policy, denominator, input IDs and unresolved/excluded treatment. Existing interview scoring is a reusable basis, not an implementation of this complete envelope. Reject making every detail a separate event and reject requiring a finished graph before useful detail output. Coordinate the bounded NMP producer profile; no producer field supplies authority.
Acceptance: one owner-decided ADR records the selected public contract, rejected alternatives and a synthetic witness for rescore-under-two-policies without re-extraction or mapping. The drafting work does not imply owner approval; no new public types land before their relevant decision.
